intro: The Scoop Robot Pro rolls to one side to empty rather than tumbling a globe, and it has been on sale only a short time, so there is little documented field experience yet. We will expand this page as CATLINK publishes support material. Until then the common troubleshooting page covers the general problems.

facts.text: Dual-band Wi-Fi, so it joins either 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz networks.
A 15 L waste bin, rated for around 20 days with one cat.

symptoms.title: Visits are credited to the wrong cat
symptoms.summary: The two cameras record visits but the app assigns them to the wrong cat.
causes: Low light or dusty camera windows reduce what the cameras can distinguish.

fixes.detail: Add a night light nearby and wipe both camera windows with a dry cloth.

symptoms.escalate: If misidentification continues in good light, raise it with CATLINK.
